title: Pigeon Craft s2
description: pigeon craft is an imaginitive minecraft series with a main topic. seasons 2 topics is combat, which adds a bunch of new structures, armour and weapons with more to be added in future updates. there will also be a youtube series coming soon on this modpack
body:
Welcome to Pigeon Craft!! Pigeon Craft is an imaginitive series of minecraft modpacks that i put together. this seasons topic is combat, meaning that we have added a bunch of mods surrounding that, this includes mods like, advance netherite, armour HUD, travelers backpack, dungeons and taverns, and more! for this season i have also decided to try and keep it more vanilla than season one so you still get a taste of how minecraft normally is without changing everything. another amaizing thing about pigeon craft is me and my friends on the official pigeon smp are going to start recording and live streaming on the server for content. each season in Pigeon Craft has a new topic and this is season 2 of pigeon craft. season 1 of pigeon craft was never officailly recorded on youtube or twitch, and was never uploaded to modrinth. disclaimer, none of the mods in the modpack where created by me

this link is an invite to [my discord server](https://discord.gg/Th3pgVCF7M)
contact me there if you have any questions, need help, want updates, or other
